c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Shotgun cycle, human-set pace ('take our time'), idea count ~15-20. Ground-the-code-first: three background research excursions (x1 circuit fingerprinting, x2 reference-lap machinery, x3 driver-side observables) run while point-questions proceed in conversation. Starting questions 1-3 are largely pre-answered by the step-back conversation (captured on the board); confirm rather than re-ask. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Shotgun cycle framed: ~15-20 ideas, unhurried, 3 grounding excursions dispatched (x1 done, x2/x3 in flight)

q1.title: The itch + done-feel, confirmed (starting Qs 1-3)
q1.imperative: Confirm the board's 'point' section captures the itch (raw classification entangles car/driver; physics should decompose), for whom (the predictive network / fantasy decisions), and done-feel (confirmed decomposition design ready to cut). One question, recommended answer, adjust board on correction.
q1.finding: Owner: TWO idealized references - one targeting quali, one targeting race. Car capabilities are the shared core; race version adds dispersion (tyre management/deg). Unified cross-driver feature = simulated segment-time DISTRIBUTIONS; segmentation granularity open (FIA sectors vs custom regime/corner-class segments)

q2.title: What already exists — reconcile owner memory with code reality (starting Q4)
q2.imperative: Owner: 'a lot of meandering; might need to talk before it holds together.' Reconcile the owner's mental model of existing pieces (course fingerprinting, ideal-lap sim, pooled estimates) against excursion findings x1-x3. Surface contradictions, don't smooth them.
q2.finding: Reconciled via x1/x2/x3 presentations: (1) #628 utilization pipeline code-complete + gate-validated but observables store never built at season scale (rerun, not engineering); (2) forgotten third lineage src/physics/ideal_lap/ ephemeris store = per-corner-segment transit times vs ideal with mgmt_discount fields, 2023-Bahrain pilot only, architecturally the owner's unified feature shape; (3) circuit rollup + utilization taxonomy are close cousins never joined. Owner memory confirmed: pieces exist, spine connecting them does not

q3.title: Kill condition sharpened (starting Q5)
q3.imperative: Confirm/sharpen the kill condition: what fact would make the decomposition frame pointless? Board draft: recomposition cannot out-predict raw timing at any granularity (class-spanning). Owner stance: null = keep working. Sharpen into something testable early.
q3.finding: OWNER: NO frame-kill condition. Fingerprint non-replication is a DIAGNOSTIC (missing structure, wrong observable) routing to more structural work, never abandonment. Build the whole connective pipeline assuming fingerprint relevance - the connections are durable assets preventing rediscovery (three unjoined lineages prove the cost). Agent's proposed decomposition-stability kill condition REJECTED by owner

q4.title: Shotgun generation: ~15-20 cheap one-liners across the open design spaces
q4.imperative: Generate ~15-20 one-liner ideas across: utilization observables (per-lap/per-corner/per-regime), circuit fingerprint forms, driver fingerprint forms, practice-update mechanisms, sizing methodologies, network entry points. Wild entries sanctioned. Human contributes; agent contributes. Cluster and cull at consolidation; culls stay on board with reasons.
q4.finding: All 22 ideas walked one-by-one with owner verdicts (harness task list #1-#22 holds per-idea metadata). Accepted-now core: segment substrate (tiling vocabulary, time ledger + energy channel, time-share fingerprint), fingerprint mechanism (per-class utilization, linear join AS THE PRIOR, Student-t shrinkage, push+managed race split), weekend machinery (two-speed F10-weighted update, canonical grip baseline intra+inter session), instrument panel (variance decomposition exit gate, split-half replication, composed-sector scorecard), sequenced integration (feature family -> choir w/ critical eye; MC predictor future; decomposed input space endpoint). Deferred by escalation principle: phases, transition axes, factorization, teammate (end-stage diagnostic only), drift. Standing principles set: lowest-dimensionality-first; heavy tails; segment correlation; no frame-kill

x1.title: Excursion: what circuit-fingerprint machinery exists in-repo?
x1.imperative: Research excursion, brief on board. One question: what course/circuit fingerprinting exists today (corner classification, regime fractions, circuit profiles, C3 circuit-conditionality artifacts), where, in what shape, and is it consumable for conditioning a driver-utilization prior? Background via run_crew registry.
x1.finding: Three unjoined fingerprint lineages found. Circuit corner-class rollup (#625/#638) validated PASS 5/5, k=4 severity ladder, 22 circuits 2019-2026, MEASURED-not-wired (zero src importers). regime_utilization.py = per-driver-lap utilization vs simulated ideal already exists. circuits.yaml = low-trust hand-tags. Full: excursions/x1-RESULT.md

x2.title: Excursion: can the sim produce a per-car weekend reference lap today, frontier-clean?
x2.imperative: Research excursion, brief on board. One question: current state of sim_evaluator + CapabilityEnvelope — can it emit a per-car per-weekend ideal lap now; which inputs are frontier-fits vs mean-fits end-to-end (circularity guard); what's missing for a reference-lap product? Background via run_crew registry.
x2.finding: Reference lap RUNS in production (#628 Path B: causal build_car_ceiling -> simulate_lap, strictly_pre anti-circularity); scalar ideal lap time computed but discarded (one-line recovery). Frontier audit: 4/5 views genuine one-sided frontier fits; coast = physics-constant ID feeding no utilization axis. Circularity worry retired. Full: excursions/x2-RESULT.md

x3.title: Excursion: what driver-side observables exist for utilization + a driver fingerprint?
x3.imperative: Research excursion, brief on board. One question: what per-driver stores/observables exist (2023-Q estimate pipeline, telemetry Parquet mirror, per-corner data) that could support per-corner/per-regime utilization measurement and a generalized driver corner-type fingerprint? Coverage and shape, not just existence. Background via run_crew registry.
x3.finding: Driver observables inventory: apex_obs per-driver per-corner 2019-2026 Q (best fingerprint substrate, needs car-normalization); #628 utilization pipeline code-complete + gate-validated but never run at season scale (rerun not engineering); ideal_lap/ephemeris = per-corner-segment transit times + mgmt_discount, Bahrain pilot only; telemetry store = ultimate fallback. Full: excursions/x3-RESULT.md

q1b.title: Segmentation vocabulary decision
q1b.imperative: Follow-up to q1: FIA sectors vs physics-native segments
q1b.finding: OWNER DECISION: custom physics-native segments, CONSTRAINED TO NEST inside FIA sectors (no segment straddles a sector boundary): segments compose to sectors compose to laps, preserving exact sector-level validation against official timing while the model reasons at segment level

consolidation.summary: Cycle 1 (shotgun) consolidated: 22 ideas -> 5 clusters (segment substrate / fingerprint mechanism / weekend machinery / instrument panel / sequenced integration) + 4 standing design principles (lowest-dimensionality-first with schema-carried escalation layers; heavy-tailed Student-t distributions; correlated segment draws; no frame-kill, nulls route to structural work) + deferred set with revival conditions. Three grounding excursions complete (x1 circuit lineages, x2 reference-lap/frontier audit, x3 driver observables). Board updated; open threads seed cycle 2.
